route_title: Periodic Quarter-Wave Bragg Stack for UV Reflection
compilation_rationale: Compiled explicit 20-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack between air and fused silica. Assuming nominal quarter-wave thicknesses (~100 nm) with broad optimization bounds (50–300 nm). Fixed relative tolerance of ±5% applied. Dual-band objectives score mean transmittance in 1000–1700 nm and mean reflectance in 300–450 nm. Coherent smatrix solver used at normal incidence.
